answer: A farm's clones share one pipe, so make presence itself the gate: each epoch, every identity must answer an unpredictable ping within a tight round-trip deadline from its own network vantage, like a jade seal stamped in real time. A hollow identity with no real operator behind it misses the window, and a relic of an old session cannot be replayed because the nonce is fresh. One thousand fakes need one thousand live connections and operators, each costing real bandwidth and attention, while an honest agent answers once and moves on; clusters whose replies arrive in lockstep are frozen as one.
